name: Slidev
description: Slidev is a slide deck maker and presenter for developers. Slides are written in Markdown with Vue components, code highlighting, LaTeX and diagrams, and served with live reload, presenter mode, remote control and a built-in MCP server that lets AI agents edit the deck.

notes.text: Slidev has no authentication: anyone who can reach port 3030 can present, edit the slides and use the MCP endpoint. Keep it on a trusted network.
The deck lives in /opt/slidev/slides.md. AI agents can edit it over MCP at http://<IP>:3030/__mcp.
To reach it through a hostname or reverse proxy, add that host to server.allowedHosts in /opt/slidev/vite.config.ts.
